description: Source code for Messenger security handling, including token validation, URL regex creation, and ACL management within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: IsAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a given token and designator are allowed by the security officer.

methods.name: CreateUrlRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern from a URL input for ACL matching.

methods.name: GetUrlOrigin
methods.description: Extracts the origin part of a URL according to RFC 3986.

methods.name: Messenger::CheckToken
methods.description: Validates a token for a specific method and parameters, with ACL and origin checks.
